lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，我推开水往前走。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail pushes the water aside.
Water slips off the ridge of my back.
On land this body is clumsy.
The river is too shallow to hold me.

lines.zh: 我一动，水底的沙就浮起来。
lines.en: When I move, the sand beneath lifts.
Four flippers row slowly, like oars.

lines.zh: 从崖蜥到现在，我游了几千万年。
lines.en: From a shore lizard to this: millions of years of swimming.
The surface is a few blocks above me.
I ride the undercurrent to save strength.

lines.zh: 脊背破开水面，又沉下去。
lines.en: My back breaks the surface, then sinks again.
The fish here all make way.
The water presses around me, comfortable.

lines.zh: 我掉头很慢，地方要够大。
lines.en: I turn slowly; I need room.
My shadow settles on the riverbed.
I hang in the dark, only my tail fin moving.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的海洋，比这里深。
lines.en: The Cretaceous sea was deeper than this.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让小鱼自己进来。
lines.en: I open my jaws and let small fish come in.
The light above me sways.
My dorsal fin stirs the water like a whetstone.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不懂水的东西下来。
lines.en: I wait for something unwise to come down.
I know this water's temperature.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我像一块礁石。
lines.en: Still, I resemble a reef.

lines.zh: 七千万年了，我还是会饿。
lines.en: Seventy million years, and I still get hungry.
I blink slowly; the water holds still.

lines.zh: 陆上动物的声音，隔着水也听见。
lines.en: I hear land animals even through the water.
My teeth have always grown backward.

lines.zh: 崖蜥的后代，如今这么大。
lines.en: A shore lizard's descendant, grown this large.
I listen to the tide from below.

lines.zh: 水面上那个人，别站太近。
lines.en: You on the bank — do not stand so close.

lines.zh: 我一半在水里，一半在看你。
lines.en: Half of me in water, half watching you.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在水里，刚好。
lines.en: You on land, I in water — that is fine.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，只到我牙高。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, barely as tall as my teeth.
Out of water, I can barely turn.
The river reaches only half my back.
You smell of dryness.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，只是想看清楚。
lines.en: I surface only to see you clearly.

lines.zh: 如果我上岸，你就会明白差距。
lines.en: If I came ashore, you would understand the gap.
These waters are mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水面碎成几块。
lines.en: Your shadow breaks into pieces on the water.

lines.zh: 手指伸进水里，会少一截。
lines.en: Put a finger in the water and you'll lose part of it.

lines.zh: 红雾从我鳞缝里涌出来。
lines.en: Red haze billows from the cracks in my scales.
The blow pushed me off course.

lines.zh: 一百五十点生命，也会疼。
lines.en: A hundred and fifty health still feels pain.
A seam opens in my scales.
I sweep my tail hard and retreat.
That struck the base of my flipper.
The water tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 我转过巨大的头，盯着你。
lines.en: I turn my huge head and stare.
This wound has slowed my swimming.
One more, and I will fight in earnest.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，我才会过去。
lines.en: Only the smell of blood draws me in.

lines.zh: 岸上的东西，我不太会吃。
lines.en: Things on land, I am not good at eating.

lines.zh: 你举起的那块肉，太干了。
lines.en: That meat you raise is too dry.
Throw it in the water and I will consider.
That meat is too dry; I turn my head away.

lines.zh: 水生动物对陆上猎物更狠。
lines.en: Water beasts strike land prey harder.
I smell fish — not that.
Let it sink and I can take it.
I approach; the surface bulges first.
Do not stand on the shallows holding things up.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的地方，是我的肋骨。
lines.en: You struck me right at the ribs.
Bumping me in the water? Bold.
I am this large, and you press against me.
The knock tilted me sideways.
My scales are slicker than you think.
Back off; I might crush you.

lines.zh: 你的脚碰到了我的下颌。
lines.en: Your foot bumps against my lower jaw.

lines.zh: 你在我侧面，正对着我的牙。
lines.en: You are at my flank, right beside my teeth.

lines.zh: 这个碰撞几乎没让我动。
lines.en: That bump barely moved me.
In the shallows neither of us is nimble.

lines.zh: 我发出很低的声音，穿过整片水。
lines.en: I make a low sound that crosses the whole water.

lines.zh: 这片河太窄，容不下两只我。
lines.en: This river is too narrow for two of me.

lines.zh: 同类的声音，要在深海里才传得远。
lines.en: Only the deep sea carries a kin's call.
I roll, showing my pale belly.
No answer, only water.
This season, the sea should be warming.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍拍了一下水面。
lines.en: My tail fin slaps the surface once.

lines.zh: 求偶要在能转身的地方。
lines.en: Courtship needs room to turn.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈游，圈越来越大。
lines.en: I swim in circles, and the circles widen.
Do not watch from the bank.
I catch a sunken bone in my teeth.
This shell is too small to bother with.

lines.zh: 沉下去的箱子，我推得动。
lines.en: A sunken chest — I can push it.
I lift a dead fish.
Too hard; it will not go down.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，慢慢试。
lines.en: I hold it in my jaws and test it slowly.
This stone is a little interesting.
What lies on the bed is mine.
I lower my head and the mud billows.
Bones sink, which suits me.
Something is moving on the bank.
A splash, and I know.

lines.zh: 我的头转向你，水跟着转。
lines.en: My head turns; the water turns with it.

lines.zh: 你还在浅水里，我已经动了。
lines.en: You're still in the shallows, and I've already moved.
You stepped into the shallows.
I have seen your feet.
My tail is already taut.
Land prey runs hotter blooded.
Do not linger at the water's edge.
My teeth are longer than your blade.
I have prepared this bite a long time.

lines.zh: 从水底看，你的轮廓很清楚。
lines.en: From below, your outline is clear.
You cannot hear me rising.

lines.zh: 你已经在我的一冲之内。
lines.en: You are already within one lunge.
I follow you along the riverbed.
One step of yours, one stretch of my swim.
The current will bring you down to me soon enough.

lines.zh: 你在桥上看，我在桥下等。
lines.en: You watch from the bridge; I wait below.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍划开水面，你看不见。
lines.en: My fin splits the surface where you cannot see.

lines.zh: 这段岸线，没有浅处给你跑。
lines.en: This shoreline offers no shallow escape.
I circle, round after round.
Your shadow grows shorter.
The current aids you and aids me.
I wait for you to enter the water.
My breathing makes the surface rise and fall.
You hear the water, do you not.

lines.zh: 尾鳍再一摆，就到你脚下。
lines.en: One more sweep and I am beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 陆上猎物要更小心，我记得。
lines.en: Land prey needs care; I remember.
I patrol every drop of this water.
My jaws close and the water is forced out.

lines.zh: 我把你从浅滩上撞下来。
lines.en: I knock you off the shallows.

lines.zh: 这一口，对陆上动物更重。
lines.en: Against land prey, this bite lands heavier.
One swing of my head sends you flying.
Do not reach out from the water's edge.
My teeth cut through water with little loss.
I bite, then drag toward the deep.

lines.zh: 尾鳍扫过来，比牙更突然。
lines.en: The tail sweeps in, more sudden than the teeth.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我这儿像树皮。
lines.en: Your armor is bark to me.
That bite missed; I come again.
The splash covers your sight.

lines.zh: 我在水里，你在水里，结束了。
lines.en: Me in water, you in water — that decides it.

lines.zh: 我的下颌比整个你更宽。
lines.en: My lower jaw is wider than all of you.
Do not struggle; it only sinks the teeth deeper.

lines.zh: 我从很深的水里升上来。
lines.en: I rise from very deep water.
My first breath is water.
The riverbed parts and I swim out.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的血，在这里重新流动。
lines.en: Cretaceous blood flows again here.

lines.zh: 我太大了，这条河装不下。
lines.en: I am too big; this river cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 脊背破水，惊飞了岸边的东西。
lines.en: My back breaks the surface and scatters the bank.
My bones are growing, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 我的第一眼，看见的是水面。
lines.en: The first thing I see is the surface.

lines.zh: 尾巴先学会用力，然后是牙。
lines.en: My tail learns force first, then my teeth.
Every fish scatters to the sides.

lines.zh: 我把头抬出水面，喘了一口空气。
lines.en: I lift my head and take one breath of air.
This water is far shallower than the sea.

lines.zh: 我是这片水新来的主人。
lines.en: I am this water's new master.
A shore lizard's descendant has returned.

lines.zh: 我第一次摆动尾鳍，就撞到河岸。
lines.en: My first tail sweep hits the bank.
The sky is cut into pieces by the surface.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了整片浅滩。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole shallows.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里有条沧龙。
lines.en: From today, a Mosasaurus lives here.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，烫得我翻滚。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and I roll in pain.

lines.zh: 我被抛上岸，重重砸在石头上。
lines.en: I am thrown ashore onto hard stone.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，却吸不到水里的空气。
lines.en: I open my jaws and get no air from the water.

lines.zh: 爆开的水压震得我内脏发痛。
lines.en: The blast's pressure aches through my insides.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭扎进我的背脊。
lines.en: A bolt sticks in my spine.

lines.zh: 紫色的东西顺着鳞片往里钻。
lines.en: Something violet crawls in under my scales.

lines.zh: 我太饿了，连摆动都没力气。
lines.en: Too hungry to even swing my tail.

lines.zh: 雷穿过水面，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning crosses the water and I lock up.
The water is gone; only emptiness below.
